decision: The competitor (Aston Martin Aramco Cognizant F1 Team) is fined €900.
event_name: Document 21 Date 22 April 2022 Time 17:30 2022 EMILIA ROMAGNA GRAND PRIX 21 - 24 April 2022 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, have considered the following matter and determine the following
offence: Breach of Article 34.7 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: Car 18 exceeded the pit lane speed limit which is set at 80 km/h for this Event by 8.2 km/h.
rules_referenced: Article 34.7 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
team: Aston Martin Aramco Cognizant F1 Team
title: Offence Car 18 Pit Lane Speeding
